author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.21.0 — Adds nextRoomDueAt: a real timestamp for when the soonest-due rotation room actually crosses its own cycle threshold, since there's no calendar-based reset (no 'every Monday') -- each room runs its own rolling last-cleaned-plus-cycle-length countdown independently. Complements nextRoomsToClean (which names the candidate) and roomsPendingThisCycle (which just counts).
